definitions.full: H8235. shiphrah I. שִׁפְרָה noun feminine fairness, clearness , of sky; — absolute ׳שׁ Job 26:13 by his breath the sky becomes fair(ness) , see especially De Di Bu Du; > Che JQ 1897, 578 (after ᵐ5 ) הוּא סֹגֵר שָׁמַיִם בְּרִיחֵי .

occurrences.englishText: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished.
